'''Gabriel''' is an NPC in [[Rinascita]] and [[Davide]]'s art broker.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Gabriel:''' Francesca has discovered a batch of potential collectibles and provided an initial valuation.
:'''Gabriel:''' Among them is one item I believe will interest you.
:'''Gabriel:''' The clean and vibrant color palette is emblematic of the creator. All proceeds from the auction will be donated to the Order of the Deep.
:'''Davide:''' ...
:'''Davide:''' Do me a favor, Gabriel.
:'''Gabriel:''' It's already arranged, Davi- I mean, anonymous buyer.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Gabriel:''' The avant-gardes of the [[New Federation]] haven't turned out anything exciting recently. I've a hunch we're not getting our money back.
:'''Gabriel:''' What do you think? Should we try our luck in Septimont, Davide? Davide?
:'''Davide:''' Huh? Oh... what was that? Sorry, I didn't catch you.
:'''Gabriel:''' What? Spent half of your life managing the Montelli family's collection and now you're seeking a fine piece of art for yourself?
:{{DIcon}} Are you talking about the painting... or the painter?
:'''Gabriel:''' Come on, you were eyeing that lady over there. Right?
:'''Davide:''' Maybe... Or maybe I'm simply attracted by that splash of bright orange tempera. A golden ray of sunshine in Salotto...
:'''Gabriel:''' She is indeed a charming lady. Got an air of timeless elegance. But judging from the Order's robe she's wearing, she must be an Acolyte.
:'''Gabriel:''' It won't be easy to have and hold this exquisite piece of art in your hands.
:'''Gabriel:''' First, you'll need permission from the Order for your union. And it's just the beginning. The rules and restrictions the Order have in place on such a partnership will simply mean you won't be able to serve the Montelli family anymore.
:'''Davide:''' I understand... despite that inappropriate analogy. There's indeed an insurmountable wall between us and this treasured "collection" of the Cathedral of Mercury...
{{Dialogue End}}
